Config.Name: PDS Hostname
Config.Description: Public hostname of the PDS (e.g. `pds.example.com`).

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection URL.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Secret used for signing JWTs. Must be at least 32 characters in production.

Config.Name: DPOP Secret
Config.Description: Secret used for DPoP proof validation. Must be at least 32 characters in production.

Config.Name: Master Key
Config.Description: Master key used for key-encryption and HKDF derivation. Must be at least 32 characters in production.

Config.Name: Server Host
Config.Description: Address to bind the HTTP server to.

Config.Name: Server Port
Config.Description: Port to bind the HTTP server to.

Config.Name: User Handle Domains
Config.Description: List of domains for user handles. Defaults to the PDS hostname when not set.

Config.Name: Available User Domains
Config.Description: List of domains available for user registration. Defaults to the PDS hostname when not set.

Config.Name: Enable PDS Hosted DID Web
Config.Description: Enable PDS-hosted did:web identities. Hosting did:web requires a long-term commitment to serve DID documents; opt-in only.

Config.Name: Age Assurance Override
Config.Description: When set to true, skip age-assurance birthday prompt for all accounts.

Config.Name: Invite Code Required
Config.Description: Require an invite code for new account registration.

Config.Name: Allow HTTP Proxy
Config.Description: Allow HTTP (non-TLS) proxy requests. Only useful during development.

Config.Name: Disable Rate Limiting
Config.Description: Disable all rate limiting. Should only be used in testing.

Config.Name: Banned Words
Config.Description: List of additional banned words for handle validation.

Config.Name: Privacy Policy URL
Config.Description: URL to a privacy policy page.

Config.Name: Terms of Service URL
Config.Description: URL to terms of service page.

Config.Name: Contact Email
Config.Description: Operator contact email address.

Config.Name: Max Blob Size
Config.Description: Maximum allowed blob size in bytes (default 10 GiB).

Config.Name: Database Max Connections
Config.Description: Maximum number of connections in the pool.

Config.Name: Database Min Connections
Config.Description: Minimum number of idle connections kept in the pool.

Config.Name: Database Acquire Timeout
Config.Description: Timeout in seconds when acquiring a connection from the pool.

Config.Name: PLC Rotation Key
Config.Description: PLC rotation key (DID key). If not set, user-level keys are used.

Config.Name: Allow Insecure Secrets
Config.Description: Allow insecure/test secrets. NEVER enable in production.

Config.Name: Blob Storage Backend
Config.Description: Storage backend: `filesystem` or `s3`.

Config.Name: Blob Storage Path
Config.Description: Path on disk for the filesystem blob backend.

Config.Name: S3 Bucket
Config.Description: S3 bucket name for blob storage.

Config.Name: S3 Endpoint
Config.Description: Custom S3 endpoint URL (for MinIO, R2, etc.).

Config.Name: Backup Enabled
Config.Description: Enable automatic backups.

Config.Name: Backup Storage Backend
Config.Description: Backup storage backend: `filesystem` or `s3`.

Config.Name: Backup Storage Path
Config.Description: Path on disk for the filesystem backup backend.

Config.Name: Backup S3 Bucket
Config.Description: S3 bucket name for backups.

Config.Name: Backup Retention Count
Config.Description: Number of backup revisions to keep per account.

Config.Name: Backup Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between backup runs.

Config.Name: Cache Backend
Config.Description: Cache backend: `ripple` (default, built-in gossip) or `valkey`.

Config.Name: Valkey URL
Config.Description: Valkey / Redis connection URL. Required when `backend = "valkey"`.

Config.Name: Ripple Bind Address
Config.Description: Address to bind the Ripple gossip protocol listener.

Config.Name: Ripple Peers
Config.Description: List of seed peer addresses.

Config.Name: Ripple Machine ID
Config.Description: Unique machine identifier. Auto-derived from hostname when not set.

Config.Name: Ripple Gossip Interval
Config.Description: Gossip protocol interval in milliseconds.

Config.Name: Ripple Cache Max MB
Config.Description: Maximum cache size in megabytes.

Config.Name: PLC Directory URL
Config.Description: Base URL of the PLC directory.

Config.Name: PLC Timeout
Config.Description: HTTP request timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: PLC Connect Timeout
Config.Description: TCP connect timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: DID Cache TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to cache DID documents in memory.

Config.Name: Firehose Buffer Size
Config.Description: Size of the in-memory broadcast buffer for firehose events.

Config.Name: Firehose Backfill Hours
Config.Description: How many hours of historical events to replay for cursor-based firehose connections.

Config.Name: Firehose Max Lag
Config.Description: Maximum number of lagged events before disconnecting a slow consumer.

Config.Name: Crawlers
Config.Description: List of relay / crawler notification URLs.

Config.Name: Mail From Address
Config.Description: Sender email address. When unset, email sending is disabled.

Config.Name: Mail From Name
Config.Description: Display name used in the `From` header.

Config.Name: Sendmail Path
Config.Description: Path to the `sendmail` binary.

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Discord bot token. When unset, Discord integration is disabled.

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Token
Config.Description: Telegram bot token. When unset, Telegram integration is disabled.

Config.Name: Telegram Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Secret token for incoming webhook verification.

Config.Name: Signal CLI Path
Config.Description: Path to the `signal-cli` binary.

Config.Name: Signal Sender Number
Config.Description: Sender phone number. When unset, Signal integration is disabled.

Config.Name: Notification Poll Interval
Config.Description: Polling interval in milliseconds for the comms queue.

Config.Name: Notification Batch Size
Config.Description: Number of notifications to process per batch.

Config.Name: SSO GitHub Enabled
Config.Description: Enable GitHub SSO.

Config.Name: SSO GitHub Client ID
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth client ID.

Config.Name: SSO GitHub Client Secret
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth client secret.

Config.Name: SSO GitHub Display Name
Config.Description: Display name for GitHub SSO.

Config.Name: SSO Discord Enabled
Config.Description: Enable Discord SSO.

Config.Name: SSO Discord Client ID
Config.Description: Discord OAuth client ID.

Config.Name: SSO Discord Client Secret
Config.Description: Discord OAuth client secret.

Config.Name: SSO Discord Display Name
Config.Description: Display name for Discord SSO.

Config.Name: SSO Google Enabled
Config.Description: Enable Google SSO.

Config.Name: SSO Google Client ID
Config.Description: Google OAuth client ID.

Config.Name: SSO Google Client Secret
Config.Description: Google OAuth client secret.

Config.Name: SSO Google Display Name
Config.Description: Display name for Google SSO.

Config.Name: SSO GitLab Enabled
Config.Description: Enable GitLab SSO.

Config.Name: SSO GitLab Client ID
Config.Description: GitLab OAuth client ID.

Config.Name: SSO GitLab Client Secret
Config.Description: GitLab OAuth client secret.

Config.Name: SSO GitLab Issuer
Config.Description: GitLab issuer URL.

Config.Name: SSO GitLab Display Name
Config.Description: Display name for GitLab SSO.

Config.Name: SSO OIDC Enabled
Config.Description: Enable generic OIDC SSO.

Config.Name: SSO OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: OIDC client ID.

Config.Name: SSO OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: OIDC client secret.

Config.Name: SSO OIDC Issuer
Config.Description: OIDC issuer URL.

Config.Name: SSO OIDC Display Name
Config.Description: Display name for OIDC SSO.

Config.Name: SSO Apple Enabled
Config.Description: Enable Apple SSO.

Config.Name: SSO Apple Client ID
Config.Description: Apple client ID.

Config.Name: SSO Apple Team ID
Config.Description: Apple team ID.

Config.Name: SSO Apple Key ID
Config.Description: Apple key ID.

Config.Name: SSO Apple Private Key
Config.Description: Apple private key.

Config.Name: Report Service URL
Config.Description: External report-handling service URL.

Config.Name: Report Service DID
Config.Description: DID of the external report-handling service.

Config.Name: Accepting Repo Imports
Config.Description: Whether the PDS accepts repo imports.

Config.Name: Max Import Size
Config.Description: Maximum allowed import archive size in bytes (default 1 GiB).

Config.Name: Max Import Blocks
Config.Description: Maximum number of blocks allowed in an import.

Config.Name: Skip Import Verification
Config.Description: Skip CAR verification during import. Only for development/debugging.

Config.Name: Scheduled Delete Check Interval
Config.Description: Interval in seconds between scheduled delete checks.
